mechanism_narrative: A higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures reducing real equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return in periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 is not significantly positive compared to the baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 280 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 0.1%, it signals a combination of high inflation and insufficient monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return in periods meeting the trigger condition is not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened inflation fears and potential policy tightening.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return in low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0) when CPIAUCSL is above 280 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 1700 thousand units signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return in periods when HOUST > 1700 is not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 (index 2017=100) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return in periods when INDPRO < 100.5 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.9% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return in periods when UNRATE < 3.9 is not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return in periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month is not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for INDPRO change as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
